title: store: save_script active=true does not deactivate siblings
description: save_script UPSERT sets active=1 for the named script but never clears active on other scripts for the same username. load_active_script uses LIMIT 1 — if two scripts are both marked active, an arbitrary winner is returned. set_active correctly deactivates all siblings in a transaction but save_script bypasses that invariant. Any caller that passes active=true to save_script when another active script exists leaves the database in an inconsistent state.
